title: Valuables Floater Premium Billing Schedule: Plans, Fees and Minimums
content:
Larkspur Valuables Floater premium billing schedule: the smallest annual premium, the billing plans each tier allows, and the fees and thresholds that apply to the floater's premium account.

| Tier | Smallest annual premium (USD) | Billing plans allowed | Service charge on each quarterly installment after the first (USD) | Fee per returned payment (USD) | Smallest midterm prorated change posted (USD) | Smallest credit balance refunded (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 50.00 | annual only | 0.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 75.00 | annual or quarterly | 4.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 100.00 | annual or quarterly | 4.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 150.00 | annual or quarterly | 3.00 | 20.00 | 2.00 | 5.00 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 250.00 | annual or quarterly | 0.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 500.00 | annual only | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 |

**Footnotes to the schedule**

1. The smallest annual premium is the least annual floater premium the tier charges.
2. The quarterly plan is available on the Select, Preferred, Prestige and Collector tiers; the Classic and Private Client tiers bill annually only. On the Collector tier the quarterly plan carries no service charge.
3. The midterm threshold concerns prorated premium changes during the term: a change below the tier's figure is neither billed nor credited. On the Collector and Private Client tiers the figure is 0.00.
4. The refund figure is the smallest credit balance that is refunded; it is 5.00 USD on every tier.
5. The Private Client tier charges no returned payment fee.

**Hypothetical application of footnote 3**

On a hypothetical Valuables Floater Prestige, a prorated change of 1.95 USD is below 2.00 USD and is neither billed nor credited; a prorated change of 2.40 USD is posted. On the Valuables Floater Select the same 2.40 USD change is below 5.00 USD and is not posted.
